notes.title: Update v0.7.0
notes.content:
Update v0.7.0

Hey everyone! In preparation for our official game announcement, we've just dropped what might be our biggest demo update yet! There's a lot to go over, so let's jump right in:

Improvements

Engineer Shield UI: Now shows which regions are being hit, and shield placement has been simplified to align with regions instead of directions. Cherry on top is it looks a lot better, too!
Pilot Rework: Improved feel, speed, and camera for a more enjoyable Pilot experience.
New Rail Gun: Replaced the Cannon with a Railgun, featuring all-new animations, mechanics, and sound effects.
Weapon Visuals & Sounds: Updated visuals and sounds on all of the Gunner's weapons.
Combat Improvements: Increased damage on all weapons, making combat feel more impactful.
Engineer Overclock: Now boosts all modules' power by 20%, instead of doubling the power of one module.
AI Enhancements: Greatly improved AI for the Gunner and Engineer when playing with fewer than 4 players.
UI Scaling: Engineer's UI scaling now works better across different monitor sizes.
Dialogue Timer: Reduced dialogue timer for snappier conversations.
Radar Improvements: Reduced clutter on the radar in all levels.
Collision SFX: Added sound effects for collisions.
Opening Sequence: Added car wash animations to the opening sequence in The Fool.
UI Enhancements: Improved tooltips and various minor UI elements for clarity.
Captain's Transmission: The Captain now defaults to the transmission tab.
Training Overhaul: Updated and shortened basic training for a smoother onboarding experience.
Dialogue Updates: Various dialogue tweaks for a better flow.


Bug Fixes

Missiles: More consistent missile behavior in space and on the missile tracker.
Role Selection: Host can no longer start the game unless all players have selected a role.
Focus Fire: Regions are now easier to select.
Color Markers: Markers are correctly removed when no longer needed.
The High Priestess: Fixed lighting in some areas of the comet.
Music Volume: Music volume is now preserved between runs.
Mara in The Fool: Fixed issue where Mara wasn't on fire for clients in The Fool.
Miscellaneous: Other small fixes and tweaks we might've forgotten to note.


Thanks again for all your support and feedback! Until next time,  
-Silenced Mage-

notes.title: UPDATE v0.5.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Captain, Pilot, and Engineer have all received plenty of attention in our previous updates, so now it’s time to give the Gunner some love—along with a host of other improvements. Here are the details:

Improvements

Cannon:
  - Rate of fire increased from 1/s to 3/s.
  - Overheat threshold raised from 5 shots to 7 shots.
  - Cannon rounds are faster and easier to hit with.
  - Improved visual indicators for round trajectory.
Laser: Damage increased from 15/s to 30/s.
Missile Pathing: Overhauled to make missiles faster and more direct.
Ion Lance: Damage increased from 50 to 150 across all regions it passes through.
Engineer: Repair speed has been significantly increased.
Pilot: Cloaking now charges faster (45s → 30s) but also depletes faster (30s → 20s).
Captain: Scan rate doubled.
Enemy Ship Balancing: Adjusted health across all enemy ships for better balance.
Dialogue Timeout: Dialogue options now have a timeout feature to prevent abuse; a random option will be chosen if none is selected in time.
Captain's Log: Now opens automatically for all other roles as a reminder that it exists.
AI Behavior: Improved collision avoidance and general behaviors.
Scrollwheel Control: Added scrollwheel icons for Gunner's Laser color and Engineer's Shield color, both of which can now be controlled via the scrollwheel.
Particle Efficiency: Improved for better performance.
Aether Eggs: Now available in all 3 demo levels.



Bug Fixes

Client Captain: Now has access to the correct dialogue options.
AI Fixes: AI no longer gets irrationally angry while in call with players and won't decide to fly off indefinitely.
Gun Vibration: Significantly reduced.
Pilot Log Scrolling: The W and S keys no longer scroll the Log for the Pilot.
Death Mission: Improved edge case handling.
Soft Shadows: Fixed on planets.
Pre-Mission Screen: No longer impacted by mission lighting and is now correctly scaled for all resolutions.
Captain’s Transmission Marker: Now correctly disappears in some unusual edge cases.
Dialogue Tweaks: A variety of small dialogue tweaks.
Miscellaneous Fixes: Several other small bug fixes.



As always, thank you for playing and for all your feedback! Now, it's time to get back to working on missions!

-Silenced Mage-

notes.title: UPDATE v0.4.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're back with another big Demo update, addressing bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements based on your feedback. Here are the details:

Improvements

New M.A.W. Option: The Pilot can now use the M.A.W. to restart the current mission. Additionally, the ability to M.A.W. to the next mission only unlocks once the current mission is either won or lost, preventing some bizarre edge cases.
UI and Suspend: The UI now functions correctly for all roles while the Captain suspends time.
Cannon Speed: Increased the Gunner's cannon travel time. 
AI Anger Management: AI is now more forgiving when being shot at by the Gunner.
Cephalor Ship Health: Reduced the health of Cephalor ships for better balance.
Pilot Alerts: Added an alert for the Pilot when under the effects of a gravity missile.
Gravity missiles: Speaking of, gravity missiles apply a slowing effect now. 
Transmission Reminder: The transmission alert now remains active while the Captain is on a call, serving as a reminder in case they switch tabs.
Dialogue and Tutorials: Improved dialogue and tutorials for a better player experience.
Updated Credits: Special thanks to our playtesters! More of you lovely people are now in the credits.



Bug Fixes

Gunner's Hell: While sustaining damage, the Gunner is no longer plunged into the fiery depths of hell (in other words, their screen is no longer consumed by fire).
The Fool: Fixed an issue causing the Cephalor in The Fool to fly away from the players.
The High Priestess: Fixed a corner case in The High Priestess that prevented a particular battle from occurring. Also fixed an issue causing players to get stuck during a sequence break. 
Objective Issues: Resolved objective inconsistencies in both The High Priestess and Death missions.
Music: The music volume now actually works.
Captain's Tutorial: Missile now correctly fires, allowing the tutorial to be completed.



Thank you for your feedback, and we look forward to hearing more from you while we continue working on the rest of the missions!

notes.title: Update v0.4.4 - The First Wave of Feedback!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're excited to announce the first update for the Into the M.A.W. demo, addressing bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements based on the community's feedback. Here are the details:

Improvements

Thrusters: No longer impacted by damage or power, making the ship's movement far more predictable.
Targeting: Replaced the Captain's Countermeasures with Targeting. At 100% scan, the Captain can target a specific region on an enemy, highlighting it red for all players and increasing damage dealt to that region and all modules within. The Captain can change the targeted region at any time, and the bonus damage is determined by how much power the Engineer puts into Targeting.
Protocols: The Captain now has a "Protocol" slider that can be adjusted at any time. The closer it is to Aggressive, the more damage the crew deals AND receives. The opposite is true closer to Defensive.
Basic Training: Made several clarifications in all 4 Basic Trainings.
Pilot's Boost: Now tied to the M.A.W. module, with an updated visual.
Gunner's Missile Options: Updated to Barrage (rapid fire but low damage), Neutron (damage + EMP effect), and Gravity (damage + slow effect). A 4th option will be unlocked during the full game's story.
Captain's Scanner UI: Improved for clarity and better information.
Unread Dialogue Notifications: Now more obvious for all players.
Captain's Suspend: Captain can now look around even while time is Suspended.
UI Tweaks: A number of small UI tweaks to all roles.
Dialogue Tweaks: A handful of dialogue updates.


Bug Fixes

Mara Appearance: Mara now correctly shows up in Death, regardless of how the Pilot flies.
Engineer's Sliders: Now correctly show arrows to represent when they can be increased and/or decreased.
Various Fixes: Many other small changes that are too numerous to list.


Thank you all for your incredible feedback (both positive and negative), and we look forward to hearing more from you!

- Silenced Mage
